subject: Contract automation procurement playbook and next steps
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Contract automation procurement playbook and next steps

Team —

Quick summary: procurement wants to consolidate our signature and CLM tooling footprint. Ironclad has the strongest integration story with our internal workflows, but ContractFlow (a smaller vendor) and DocuSign (existing relationship) have viable alternatives. I attached the vendor pricing sheet I pulled together.

Asks:
- Laura: please prioritize a redline pass on the SOW focusing on data residency, access to audit logs, and termination/exit assistance. See attached "Redwood_SOW_Redlines_2026.docx".
- Markus: can you confirm the preferred payment cadence (annual vs multi-year) and whether we can push for a performance SLA credit? I attached the raw pricing export (Ironclad_Pricing_Q3.pdf).
- Stephanie: can you coordinate a 45-min sync with the vendor and Product next week? Prefer Tue/Wed morning PST.

Goal: pick a preferred vendor and a fallback, get redlines in parallel, and aim to have commercial terms ready for the exec approval queue by 2026-05-14.

Thanks —
Jordan
Director, Platform Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Ironclad_Pricing_Q3.pdf, Redwood_SOW_Redlines_2026.docx

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract automation procurement playbook and next steps

Jordan —

Thanks for the summary and the SOW. I did a first-pass redline and flagged the high-priority legal items:

1) Data residency & processing: vendor must commit to storing Redwood customer PII in approved regions or provide a documented subprocess for encryption-in-transit and at-rest with KMS controls.
2) Audit logs & exportability: we need a contractual obligation to provide read-only audit exports within 24 hours for security incident response.
3) Indemnity & liability cap: propose carving out IP infringement for the vendor and tightening the liability cap for breaches involving customer data.
4) Termination assistance: add a clause for export of contract metadata and bulk document export in a machine-readable format within 30 days.

I attached "Redwood_SOW_Redlines_2026.docx" with inline comments. For negotiation playbook: prioritize data residency + logs first, then economics (discounts), then SLA credits.

I'll stand up a sec-review session Wed 11:00 PT if that works.

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal — Contracts & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_Redlines_2026.docx

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 3 May 2026 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract automation procurement playbook and next steps

Jordan / Laura —

Updated on the finance side after reviewing the Ironclad pricing sheet:
- Base list for 1,000 users: $124k/year.
- We can get to ~10-15% off for a 2-year commit, ~18-22% for 3-year commit + prepay.
- Integration credit: we should request a $10k onboarding credit given we already have a Redwood-side connector dev.

Questions for negotiation:
- Can Ironclad provide a service credit for missed latency/SLA targets or limit obligation to scaled refunds? I prefer a performance SLA with defined credits instead of open-ended refunds.
- For bookkeeping, we prefer an annual invoice on Net30; if vendor insists on prepay for the discount, we need to see the math for ROIC.

I've attached a short spreadsheet with TCO scenarios (requested as Ironclad_Pricing_Q3.pdf originally). Will follow up with numbers for 2- vs 3-year.

Markus
Head of Finance — Procurement & Vendor Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Ironclad_Pricing_Q3.pdf

From: Elena Moreno <elena@ironclad.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 08:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract automation procurement playbook and next steps

Hi Jordan / Laura / Markus / Stephanie —

Appreciate the detail. I attached an updated quote and an SOW that incorporates the exportability commitments and a standard audit log access clause. Highlights:
- Pricing: 3-year term gets 12% discount off list if paid annually, 18% if paid upfront.
- Integration credit: we can apply a $10k credit against the first invoice for your connector work.
- SLA: we can add a 99.5% uptime SLA with rolling 30-day credits for missed targets (credit schedule in the SOW).
- Data residency: for EU customers we can guarantee EU storage; for US customers we'll provide region-tagging and a documented encryption/KMS posture (not full physical segregation unless required by regulation).

Attachments: Ironclad_Quote_RC-8072.pdf, Ironclad_SOW_RC-8072.docx

If helpful, I can schedule a technical deep-dive with your integrations lead and our product engineer on Tue 2026-05-05 10:00 PT. Also happy to run a 15-min commercial call to finalize discount structure.

Best,
Elena Moreno
Enterprise Sales — Ironclad
elena@ironclad.com

Attachments: Ironclad_Quote_RC-8072.pdf, Ironclad_SOW_RC-8072.docx

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Moreno <elena@ironclad.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Aria LegalTech <aria@contractflow.io>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contract automation procurement playbook and next steps

Thanks everyone —

Plan of record:
1) Laura: please push your redlines into the Ironclad_SOW_RC-8072.docx Eli sent and mark the data residency + audit export clauses as non-negotiable for Exec review. If anything else is high-risk legal, flag it ASAP.
2) Markus: proceed to lock the 3-year commercial offer if the prepay math works; otherwise request annual billing with the 12% discount. Ask for the $10k onboarding credit in writing in the SOW.
3) Stephanie: schedule two calls — (a) Tech deep-dive with Ironclad (Tue 05/05 10:00 PT) and (b) Commercial close call (15 min) Wed 05/06 09:00 PT.

If we can get these completed by next Wed we can route to Execs for sign-off the following week.

Jordan
Director, Platform Integrations
Redwood Inference
